gems.title: 荒野丛林
gems.summary: 普鲁和同班同学柯蒂斯误入一片禁忌魔法森林，林中遍布魔法生灵、忠心伙伴与强大劲敌。二人踏上一场凶险万分的营救之旅，要从神秘女子亚历山德拉统领的鸦群手中，救出被掳走的婴儿弟弟麦克。
gems.summaryEn: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted ba
gems.whyWatch: 高口碑奇幻动画冒险，禁忌森林与营救之旅兼具童趣、想象力和紧张感。
gems.whyWatchEn: A high-rated fantasy animation adventure that blends childhood wonder, imaginative world-building, and a tense rescue quest.
gems.audience: 喜欢吉卜力式奇幻、家庭冒险和精美动画的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who love Ghibli-esque fantasy, family adventures, and visually rich animation.

gems.title: 你能看到一切
gems.summary: 在被判入狱前的34天，臭名昭著的硅谷创始人伊丽莎白·霍姆斯邀请了一支持怀疑态度的摄制组记录她的一举一动。起初这是一部关于神秘罪犯的私密肖像，却演变成一场持续3年、坠入深渊的迷幻之旅。
gems.summaryEn: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enig
gems.whyWatch: 纪录片、恐怖与戏剧边界模糊，以元叙事近距离凝视硅谷骗局主角，独特且令人不安。
gems.whyWatchEn: A genre-blurring documentary-horror-drama that uses meta-narrative to intimately and unsettlingly observe a Silicon Valley fraud figure.
gems.audience: 对真实犯罪、媒体伦理、硅谷丑闻和实验影像感兴趣的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers interested in true crime, media ethics, Silicon Valley scandals, and experimental nonfiction.

gems.title: 黑球
gems.summary: 三个同性恋男子在西班牙历史上1932 年、1937 年和 2017 年三个不同时期的故事。
gems.summaryEn: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.
gems.whyWatch: 跨越三个历史时期的同性情感与战争创伤叙事，视角稀缺，兼具时代厚度与私人痛感。
gems.whyWatchEn: A rare multi-era story of queer love and wartime trauma, combining historical sweep with intimate pain.
gems.audience: 喜欢历史语境下少数群体叙事、战争创伤和文学性剧情的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers drawn to minority narratives in historical contexts, war trauma, and literary drama.

gems.title: 登峰传奇：丹增诺盖
gems.summary: 根据真实事件改编。喜马拉雅登山家丹增·诺盖与新西兰登山家埃德蒙·希拉里携手登顶珠穆朗玛峰，成为首批登顶者。在妻子达瓦和探险队秘书吉尔·亨德森的支持下，丹增争取加入英国登山队，在攀登过程中面对文化差异、阶级矛盾与高山险境。
gems.summaryEn: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.
gems.whyWatch: 真实登山史诗聚焦丹增·诺盖，以文化差异与珠峰首登背后的合作重塑传奇。
gems.whyWatchEn: A true mountaineering epic centered on Tenzing Norgay, reframing the Everest legend through cultural difference and partnership.
gems.audience: 喜欢真实探险故事、历史传记和极限环境人性叙事的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who enjoy true exploration stories, historical biopics, and human drama in extreme environments.

gems.title: 猫鼬
gems.summary: 一位被冤枉的战争英雄，一无所有，在昔日特种部队成员的帮助下，与警方展开了一场史诗般的全国汽车追逐，全程电视直播。而着迷的公众则密切关注着他，希望他能安全逃脱。
gems.summaryEn: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fasc
gems.whyWatch: 被冤战争英雄引发全国直播追车，概念高燃，兼具动作张力与媒体时代讽刺。
gems.whyWatchEn: A wrongly accused war hero sparks a live-broadcast national car chase, delivering high-octane action with media-age satire.
gems.audience: 喜欢高概念追车动作、媒体讽刺和亡命逃脱题材的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of high-concept chase action, media satire, and fugitive thrillers.

gems.title: 侠探杰克
gems.summary: 退役宪兵杰克·雷彻独自游走各地，凭借敏锐头脑与强悍身手追查案件，在一次次危机中揭开隐藏于罪案背后的阴谋。
gems.summaryEn: 退役宪兵杰克·雷彻独自游走各地，凭借敏锐头脑与强悍身手追查案件，在一次次危机中揭开隐藏于罪案背后的阴谋。
gems.whyWatch: 硬汉侦探与动作犯罪结合，单元案件节奏利落，适合追求爽感与推理的观众。
gems.whyWatchEn: A hard-boiled detective series with brisk procedural cases and action-crime momentum, built for satisfying mystery and momentum.
gems.audience: 喜欢硬汉侦探、动作犯罪和单元破案的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who like hard-boiled detectives, action crime, and case-of-the-week storytelling.

gems.title: 水晶湖
gems.summary: 《十三号星期五》系列电影的前传剧集。一年前，单亲母亲帕姆·沃赫斯的年幼儿子杰森在湖中溺亡，她始终无法走出丧子之痛。两名陌生人登门调查她的过去，一连串诡异事件随之发生，令水晶湖镇的居民开始怀疑：帕姆·沃赫斯究竟是什么人？
gems.summaryEn: 《十三号星期五》系列电影的前传剧集。一年前，单亲母亲帕姆·沃赫斯的年幼儿子杰森在湖中溺亡，她始终无法走出丧子之痛。两名陌生人登门调查她的过去，一连串诡异事件随之发生，令水晶湖镇的居民开始怀疑：帕姆·沃赫斯究竟是什么人？
gems.whyWatch: 经典砍杀宇宙的前传新解，以母亲创伤撬动小镇恐怖，慢热悬疑感突出。
gems.whyWatchEn: A fresh prequel to a slasher icon, using a mother’s grief to unnerve the town with slow-burn mystery and horror.
gems.audience: 恐怖片粉丝、《十三号星期五》系列观众和慢热悬疑爱好者。
gems.audienceEn: Horror fans, Friday the 13th followers, and slow-burn mystery lovers.

gems.title: 赛博朋克：边缘行者
gems.summary: 夜之城每一季都有新故事，也总有一群特立独行的新角色登场，讲述属于他们的传奇。
gems.summaryEn: 夜之城每一季都有新故事，也总有一群特立独行的新角色登场，讲述属于他们的传奇。
gems.whyWatch: 夜之城新群像传奇，霓虹暴力与悲剧情感双重暴击，动画表现力极强。
gems.whyWatchEn: A new ensemble legend in Night City, delivering neon violence and tragic emotion with striking animated expression.
gems.audience: 科幻动画迷、赛博朋克粉丝和喜欢高能悲剧群像的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Sci-fi animation fans, cyberpunk enthusiasts, and viewers who love high-energy tragic ensembles.
